verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a large serverless catalog of 100+ open-source models, and its dedicated-endpoint docs show deploying a recent model (google/gemma-4-E4B-it), which hints that new open-weight releases get added. Nothing in the pack shows how quickly models arrive after public release, so the time-to-availability core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented release-to-availability timelines or day-zero launch commitments, a changelog or new-model announcement cadence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.
